scope: T04 services draft and shared button proposal
prompt:
Transform the referenced Randevu desktop design proposal into ONE tall MOBILE design presentation sheet showing TWO separate 390px-wide app viewport designs side by side, each about 1050px tall, at legible high-resolution portrait scale. These are two independent pages, not a desktop split view. No device hardware, browser bars, hand, perspective or decorative frame. Reference role: exact settled pale blue-white palette, Randevu wordmark, system sans typography, thin dividers, fictional salon-service sample data, flat minimal filled button hierarchy; reference desktop sidebars MUST NOT be copied into mobile. Reflow task layout rather than shrink desktop content.

LEFT mobile page is /yonetim/hizmetler list, collapsed navigation. A modest header with serif TEXT Randevu at left, compact filled navy Menü at right. Below, heading Hizmetler and short subtitle Hizmetlerin adını, süresini ve fiyatını yönetin. One compact, text-width filled blue Yeni hizmet button. List is open rows with thin dividers, no nested cards. Rows: Saç kesimi on top then 30 dk · 350,00 TL, explicit Aktif and a compact filled navy Düzenle button to the right of the row; Sakal düzenleme, 20 dk · 200,00 TL, Aktif, Düzenle; Saç ve sakal, 50 dk · 500,00 TL, Aktif, Düzenle; Bakım uygulaması, 40 dk · 450,00 TL, Pasif, Düzenle. Use comfortably wrapped text if needed, no clipping or horizontal overflow. Rows have only Düzenle, not extra status/delete buttons. Footer compact Listeyi yenile button on its own action row; pagination next row Önceki disabled, plain Sayfa 1, Sonraki. These pagination controls must FIT one mobile line. No fake search/filter, counts, appointments or statistics.

RIGHT mobile page is /yonetim/hizmetler/example/duzenle. Same header with collapsed Menü. Compact pale-solid filled Listeye dön, heading Saç kesimi and text Aktif. SINGLE COLUMN form; labeled Hizmet adı with value Saç kesimi, Süre (dakika) with value 30, Fiyat (TL) with value 350,00. Labels always outside fields. Three full-width fields only; buttons NEVER become full-width blocks. Compact blue Kaydet and navy Vazgeç fit together on a row, with 16px gap between action rows. A compact navy Güncel kaydı yükle on its own next row. A fine horizontal divider then Durum ve silme heading, explanatory text Pasifleştirme kaydı korur. Silme listeden kaldırır; değişiklik geçmişi korunur. Compact navy Pasifleştir and red Sil side by side, initiating separate confirmation. No list below the form, no open modal, no fake success message, no clipped footer.

MOST IMPORTANT shared minimalist button rules: each accessible hit target is at least 44 by 44 CSS px, but width follows its text instead of an oversized fixed width; button label around 14px medium-weight system sans; 12px horizontal padding; modest 6px corners; solid FLAT opaque blue #4C72AD primary / navy #405775 secondary / very pale #EDF1F7 navigation / red #A44D45 destructive; white text on the dark colors. NO shadow, no glossy treatment, no bevel, no gradient, no transparency, no outline-only secondary buttons, no decorative icons. Body and labels around16px, mobile task heading32px. The surface is #FAFBFD, fields white, ink #253044 and fine pale borders. Clearly smaller and calmer visual mass than the incumbent app while retaining touch usability and readable labels. Preserve 16px vertical gap between separate action rows. Native task interface not marketing. No photos, logo icon, additional modules or claims. Exact Turkish spelling. The tiny bottom labels may say Liste and Düzenleme and are part of the presentation, not app content. Values are synthetic examples; static draft only, not runtime/API evidence.
